players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.detail: Key passes: 4 (top quarter of forwards: 2+); 3 assists, 4 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 33% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central areas inside the box; low-angle and long-range efforts are what miss the target.
Take an extra touch to set your body if you have space - off-balance shots fly wide.
If the angle is tight, cut it back to a teammate instead of shooting.

weaknesses.detail: 23/33 passes (70%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below ~72% accuracy every extra pass costs rating. Take the simple option until the accuracy comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the shoulder - otherwise recycle or switch play.
If nothing is on, keep the ball: shield, turn back, and let the shape reset.

players.headline: Strong forward performance (8.8, top 25% for the position) - best at getting shots off, chance creation; work on shot selection, forcing passes.

players.name: BellyTb1

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 50% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Use one- and two-touch passing in triangles; hold the ball only when you have space to turn.
Default to the simple ground pass to the open, facing teammate; save driven and lobbed passes for clear lanes.
Scan before receiving: know your next pass before the ball arrives so you are not passing under pressure.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane rather than lunging at the ball carrier from behind.
Jockey first and stay goal-side; only commit when the attacker's touch pushes the ball away from their body.
Every missed tackle opens a gap behind you. If unsure, contain and let a covering teammate step in.

players.headline: Outstanding midfielder performance (8.7, top 10% for the position) - best at goal threat; work on passing accuracy, tackle timing.

players.name: tuxedo_slide

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the centre-backs: stay between the ball and your goal, and intercept rather than chase.
Engage the ball carrier: a won tackle is worth ~0.2 rating and even a 12% success rate pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box; most goals against come from unmarked late runs.

weaknesses.detail: 10/21 passes (48%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below ~72% accuracy every extra pass costs rating. Take the simple option until the accuracy comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the shoulder - otherwise recycle or switch play.
If nothing is on, keep the ball: shield, turn back, and let the shape reset.

weaknesses.detail: 0 goals from 3 shots on target - the keeper is getting to them
weaknesses.title: Finishing
tips: Your shots are on target but the keeper is getting to them: aim for the corners, not the middle.
Use finesse shots to the far post from angles; use low driven shots one-on-one.
Only use timed finishing when you're confident in the timing; a normal shot to the corner beats a mistimed one.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.2, below average for the position) - work on defensive work rate, forcing passes.
